summary.intent: Run the GSD manager dashboard to work through the v1.1 hardening block (phases 51–55), discussing phases inline while planning runs in background agents to parallelize work across the 5 remaining phases.
summary.outcome: Phases 51, 52, and 53 all reached 'discussed' state with CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md committed; planners for phases 51 and 52 were launched in isolated worktrees and running at session end; phase 53 context was committed but planning not yet started.

repo: The GSD dep parser misparses 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' — it splits on parentheses and produces a phantom dep '1.1', causing all phases 51–55 to show deps_satisfied:false and recommended_actions to return empty despite all being unblocked.

Phase 50 carries a stale is_active:true / roadmap_complete:false flag in the init query even though ROADMAP has it marked [x] complete and it shipped in PR #527 — the flag is not reliably cleared on completion.

Todo #15 bundled two distinct concerns: Faro transport wiring (end-user monitoring) and logger redact() interceptor (secret-leak guard). The redaction interceptor's acceptance criteria require Faro to verify it, so both were deferred together to a future observability phase.

Phase 53 todo #16 root cause: the release-please sdk-loop happened because a force-push orphaned the bot's release-target commit and cancel-in-progress killed the recompute. 'Satisfied' pin clearing is a band-aid for a symptom; fixing recompute reliability is the real fix.

Phase 53 todo #6: ~111 third-party GitHub Actions uses need SHA-pinning; internal reusable-workflow refs are excluded. Dependabot github-actions ecosystem is a critical companion — pins go stale without it.

core.hooksPath in this repo is set to an absolute path pointing to the main tree's .husky directory, so worktree commits attempt to run the same pre-commit hook (pnpm lint-staged) and require node_modules in the worktree.
The GSD commit helper auto-switches branches on the first phase commit (main → feat/<slug>), which means a background planner sharing the main tree inherits the branch switch mid-run.

code.finding: HARD-02 entry was narrowed to remove Faro/logging scope (todo #15 dropped) — now covers only IPNS crypto-signature findings S1/S2/S3.
Phase 51 one-liner was updated to remove 'Secret-Leak' framing after dropping todo #15; also the captured-todos scope list and goal/requirement block were edited to match.

Contains a stale canonical ref path — todo #15 file reference points to .planning/todos/pending/ but the path was noted as slightly off; the correction was deferred to the planner rather than committed separately.

workflow: Claude Code background agents launched with Agent(run_in_background=true) DO have access to the Agent tool (Tools:* granted to general-purpose and claude subagent types), so the manager workflow's blanket 'no nesting in background on Claude Code' guardrail is overly conservative for this harness.

Running plan-phase in a background agent without isolation:worktree puts it in the shared main tree; when the GSD commit helper auto-branches on first commit it can yank the branch from under a parallel agent and cause index.lock collisions.

Worktree isolation pattern for parallel planning: checkout main in main tree, git worktree add on the feature branch, symlink or pnpm-install node_modules in the worktree so husky hooks can run, then spawn the planner agent pointed at the worktree path.
Symlinking node_modules into a worktree is fragile (shared-tree leak risk); pnpm i inside the worktree gives proper isolated deps and is the safer approach.

Session/usage limits can interrupt background agents mid-run with no recovery signal; always check git state in the worktree (uncommitted changes, HEAD, index.lock) before restarting to avoid re-doing or double-applying work.
The GSD commit helper emits commit_failed as a false negative — verify with git log rather than trusting the helper's return status.

friction: GSD dep parser phantom-dep bug: 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' parsed as deps [49, '1.1'], causing all 5 hardening phases to show blocked and recommended_actions to return empty — manager showed no suggestions despite all phases being actionable.
Phase 50 stale active flag in init query required manual cross-check against ROADMAP and git log to confirm it was actually done.

First background planner (phase 51) was launched without worktree isolation, requiring it to be TaskStop'd, the tree inspected, and the whole worktree setup done before relaunch — ~6 extra tool calls.

Session limit hit partway through Phase 52 discussion, cutting off the background planner for phase 51 that had just restarted; required manual restart and state verification at the exact reset moment.
Husky hook requires node_modules in worktree; symlink approach was tried then reverted in favor of pnpm i, adding setup time to each worktree planner launch.
Commit helper false-negative on commit_failed required a separate git log verification step after every commit.
